source: Robert relayed Grok Bot's marketing and backend preview review in this chat,18October2026.
authority: Review and add to the same comments register only. Third-party recommendations are feedback, not instructions, accepted product policy, deployment/provider authority or permission to send/publish/change statuses.
previewVersion: Reviewer did not supply a deployment URL or timestamp. Ambient URL is old read-only review; current editable QA Preview is separate. Do not assume every observation concerns the latest deployment.

positives.marketing: Home/product/access/sign-in/terms/privacy reportedly look premium and honest. Charcoal/green consistent within reviewed pages; convincing Oak & Stone illustrative proposal; careful scope and preview banner. These are reviewer observations, not global branding/accessibility acceptance.
positives.backend: Reviewer reports brief wizard,1000beforeVAT/1200includingVAT,20Oct-2Nov programme/timeline, clean proposal/12terms/PDFbutton and helpful checklist. Job1 reportedly lacks onlypayment stages; job2 lacks3items. This is view-only reviewer evidence, not an independently repeated save/reload/PDF/legal/financial/calendar acceptance test.

comments.reported: Every Open Constructa button goes to sign-in. Gate 9 wants one Apply to the founding cohort button; no way for a contractor to raise their hand for 7 Dec.
comments.assessment: Confirmed CTA routing/capture gap in phase-one source. Exact Gate9 document and7December commitment not supplied or located in the scoped records; retain as reported governance reference, not verified launch authority.

comments.reported: Product and access pages mostly repeat the home page, without real product screenshots beyond the mock-up.
comments.assessment: Confirmed shared Journey/Scope/Questions/Invitation reuse and illustrative proposal, not real product screenshot coverage. Existing construction photo is not a product screenshot. Different page purpose and synthetic/anonymised captures are appropriate; richer imagery remains Later under existing phase tagging.

comments.reported: Small grey-on-charcoal text is hard to read and will probably fail accessibility contrast checks.
comments.assessment: Small type is confirmed, including10-12px and smaller illustration labels. Blanket contrast-failure claim not confirmed: sampled declared foreground/background pairs exceed4.5:1. Actual rendered gradients, opacity, focus/disabled states and complete interface still require measured audit.
comments.classification: Readability issue confirmed; blanket contrast claim not established

comments.reported: Sign-in's01-04 numbers sit one row off their labels, and a3-step onboarding progress bar shows while signing in.
comments.assessment: Confirmed shared FirstSessionPanel always renders Account/Essentials/Workspace progress for step0 sign-in. Right-panel numbers use vertical centering beside combined title/detail blocks, consistent with reported alignment concern; exact rendered geometry not independently rechecked.

comments.reported: March terms/privacy placeholders overclaim manage projects and signup for updates, and say nothing about UK GDPR; A023/A024 are critical-path.
comments.assessment: Confirmed March2026 wording, broad manage-projects purpose, signup-for-updates claim and absolute third-party-sharing/security assurances. Privacy content omits substantive purposes/lawful bases/retention/recipients/transfers/rights/complaint information. A UK GDPR label alone is not a remedy. Review actual processing and obtain appropriate legal review; platform terms/privacy remain separate from proposal terms A067/A068.
comments.classification: Confirmed incomplete content; not a legal compliance certification

comments.reported: The/pricing route is labelled Access without prices; About preview access links to the page already open; how-it-works card arrows do not go anywhere.
comments.assessment: Confirmed route/label mismatch and Scope self-link on PhaseOnePricing. Journey arrows are aria-hidden decorative SVGs, not broken anchors. Clarify visual affordance or provide genuine destinations; do not make decoration focusable or invent subscription prices.

comments.reported: Flow stops after proposal: nowhere for client response or Mark as Won; Won only in filter, with Mark as Lost and Pull Back controls.
comments.assessment: Not correct as a blanket implementation-absence claim. Public /proposal/[token] page/response-client/action and board Mark as Won on Proposal Sent exist. Client response intentionally records non-binding receipt/intent, not contractual acceptance. Preview blocks public proposal, publication/send, dashboard POST and accepted-status writes. End-to-end finish line remains unverified; do not enable sending/acceptance or assume response means Won.
comments.classification: Preview restriction plus unverified lifecycle; existing capability confirmed in source

comments.reported: Job2 is Estimating with a Proposal Sent button despite nothing sent and3missing items; job1 remains Lead after brief/estimate/programme are done.
comments.assessment: Confirmed Estimating card shows a next-action labelled Proposal Sent; it is not itself proof the saved status is sent. More serious: board updateStatusAction accepts lifecycle status without readiness/publication verification; markAsWonAction writes Active/accepted/accepted_at; both ignore database errors before success, and client is optimistic without rollback. QA guard blocks dashboard mutations and accepts only narrowly scoped saved-job edits. Exact reported job state was not reread and fixture state is not new automatic-transition evidence. Trace all save/status paths before defining automatic stage policy.
comments.classification: Confirmed action/lifecycle risk; reported saved-state behaviour unverified

comments.reported: Opening Brief without selecting a job silently loads job2 while sidebar says Select a project; sidebar then retains whichever job was last opened.
comments.assessment: Confirmed source mismatch: brief page independently falls back to newest allProjects[0] when no projectId; sidebar uses URL projectId and localStorage, and does not adopt that server fallback. Remembering a valid last selection is intentional; silent fallback and contradictory loaded-job indication need a shared resolution contract. Do not regress existing dirty-editor guards or replace invalid requested IDs with another job.

comments.reported: Admin Dashboard sidebar link opens a bare403 page with no way back.
comments.assessment: Source confirms isAdmin can expose link from ADMIN_EMAIL while review proxy refuses/admin before styled layout. Protected-route refusal is intended; visible forbidden entry/poor fallback is a presentation defect, not permission to open admin or weaken authentication.

comments.reported: Resource Management and Financial Dashboard are future-update placeholders; hide them for cohort.
comments.assessment: Confirmed dashboard bottom placeholder panels are unconditionally rendered. Cohort-only hiding fits phase-one scope; preserve full-profile/later-phase implementation and do not fabricate metrics.

comments.reported: Sidebar section labels are small grey text on black and hard to read.
comments.assessment: Confirmed10px uppercase section labels. Nominal slate400/black contrast is8.19:1, so small size/weight/readability should not be mislabelled a proven contrast failure. Chevron slate600/black sample2.77:1 needs actual background/control-state assessment.
comments.classification: Confirmed small type; full contrast audit pending

consoleAndConduct: Reviewer reports only Vercel preview-feedback-script CSP refusal and no other errors/broken pages within their tour; no changes, sends or generation. Retain CSP/provider restrictions. This is not proof of universal console health or complete side-effect telemetry.
